slides.title: How could this Monday get any better?
slides.body: Contractor edition. 6:45 AM. Crew's already at the site.

slides.label: 6:52 AM
slides.title: The GC emails: "Your COI on file expired last week."

slides.label: 7:05 AM
slides.title: Your insurance agent's office opens at 9.

slides.label: 7:20 AM
slides.title: While digging through email, you notice your license renewal is due this month too.
slides.body: Nobody remembers who handled it last year.

slides.label: 8:40 AM
slides.title: Crew is getting paid to drink gas station coffee.
slides.body: Progress on the job so far: a very clean truck.

slides.label: Sunday night move
slides.title: Check every end date before Monday checks them for you.
slides.body: COI, license, permits, vehicle policy. Five minutes. Save this. What's your worst Monday surprise?
